name: Figma
desc: Collaborative interface design with components and dev mode. Use as the source of truth designers and engineers share.

name: Penpot
desc: Open-source design tool built on web standards, self-hostable. Use when design files cannot live on someone else's cloud.

name: Framer
desc: Design and publish a real site from the canvas. Use for marketing pages the design team owns end to end.

name: Excalidraw
desc: Hand-drawn style diagrams that nobody mistakes for a finished spec. Use for architecture sketches in a meeting.

name: Style Dictionary
desc: Compiles design tokens into CSS, iOS and Android formats. Use when one palette must ship to several platforms.

name: React Aria
desc: Adobe behaviour hooks with serious accessibility and i18n. Use as the foundation under a custom design system.

name: Lucide
desc: Clean consistent open-source icon set with tree-shaking. Use as the default icon library for new projects.

name: Simple Icons
desc: Brand logos with official colours as SVG. Use for tech stack diagrams and integration pages, exactly like this app does.

name: Heroicons
desc: Icon set from the Tailwind team in outline and solid. Use when the project already uses Tailwind.

name: Font Awesome
desc: Enormous icon catalogue covering brands and oddities. Use when you need one obscure glyph nobody else draws.

name: Google Fonts
desc: Free web fonts with easy self-hosting. Use unless brand guidelines demand a licensed typeface.

name: Motion
desc: Declarative animation and gestures for React, including layout transitions. Use for polished UI motion without keyframes.

name: GSAP
desc: Timeline-based animation with precise sequencing and scroll triggers. Use for marketing sites with choreographed motion.

name: Lottie
desc: Plays After Effects animations as vector JSON. Use when a motion designer hands you the animation.
